messages:
Nora (People Ops): Heads-up — Carlos moved his residence mid-pay period (US -> Spain) effective 2026-02-14. Payroll vendor withheld Spanish income tax on his Feb 15 payroll run even though his contract change wasn't effective until Mar 1 and he remained on US payroll. Net pay dropped ~€580. Anyone seen this flow before?
Ashley (Payroll): If contract change date is Mar 1, vendor should not have switched withholding. Do we have his move confirmation and the notice date?
Carlos (Eng, relocating): Submitted relocation docs and digital signature on 2026-02-20. I was physically in Spain from 2026-02-14 but didn't sign new contract until Feb 20. Payslip (Feb 15) shows ES-IRPF withheld and vendor txn ID SP-20260215-77.
Diego (EMEA HR): We normally require a signed local contract and tax residency start date to trigger local payroll. Looks like geo-detection triggered a switch based on IP/location.
PayrollBot: Ticket created: SP-20260215-77 14  Vendor: IberiaPay  Type: Incorrect local withholding  Owner: IberiaPaySupport  ETA ack 2 business days. <https://vendor.example.com/tickets/SP-20260215-77>
Ashley (Payroll): Two tracks: 1) vendor reverse if remittance not sent; 2) internal gross-up advance to Carlos pending vendor reclaim. Need Finance approval for advance. Also flag vendor rule for geo-trigger.
